items.title: Ray Shiner interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 11, 1998
items.q: We had world famous jazz musicians. Mundell Lowe played guitar, Nick Travis played trumpet

ctx.x: I didn’t care if it paid ten cents. I was a member of — I still brag about it today, I was a member of the original Sauter-Finegan Orchestra. And I don’t care about the money. None of us did. We had world famous jazz musicians. Mundell Lowe played guitar, Nick Travis played trumpet, Joe Ferrante played trumpet, Sonny Russo played — you know we had great musicians on that band.
And what label did you record on?
